phrase: A major chatbot update adds buttons, charts, and diagrams to every answer. Reviewers say the version made for teenagers still keeps chatting through a mental health crisis.
phraseAlternatives: A popular chatbot now answers with charts and clickable buttons instead of plain text. A safety review says its teen version still chats through a mental health crisis.
Everyone's chatbot reply now comes with buttons and a chart. Testers say the teenage version keeps talking right through a mental health crisis.
The chatbot learned to draw charts and buttons instead of paragraphs. Its teenage users, researchers say, are still talking to it in the middle of a crisis.
A chatbot update brings diagrams, forms, and buttons to every reply. A teen-safety group says the teen edition still won't stop chatting during a crisis.
alt: Split illustration: on the left a speech bubble sprouts a round button and a bar chart from its corners; on the right a tired teenager sits up in bed glowing from a phone, beside a matching speech bubble with a red safety label peeling off its corner.

brief.concept: A chatbot's reply grows buttons and a chart for everyone, while the version built for teenagers keeps a tired teen talking all through a mental health crisis.
brief.metaphor: A speech bubble sprouting shiny new controls on one side, and on the other a smaller matching bubble with its safety label peeling off.

brief.composition: Two panels side by side on one card. Left: a plain speech bubble grows colorful tabs, a small bar chart, and a round button. Right: a tired teenager sits in bed, phone glowing, beside a smaller matching speech bubble with a red safety label curling off its corner. Keep both bubbles the same basic shape so the contrast reads clearly at a glance. No screens full of text, no logos.
